notes.content:
[list]
[*] Mystery Manor is going on vacation! The fiery fashionista Adele welcomes you to the tropical beach. Adventures and juicy prizes are already waiting for you!
[*] New season! Dive into urban noir and investigate a series of deaths. What traumatic events of the past were the deceased hiding? A city of contrasts, era of decadence, and the boomerang principle in action...
[*] Josh Ginger Beard and the Ghost of Pirate are calling you on an adventure! Meet Cpt. Xana and find the Treasure of Davy Jones.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Seaside Fitness Marathon — sounds great, right? A fitness instructor named Gray DeLong has already prepared everything to boost your wellness! Board the bus near the Manor to reach the destination!
[*] We also improved the app's overall stability. Have fun playing!
[/list]

[list]
[*] Boarding starts soon: the Vanquisher of the Sky invites you to the airship! Get ready for a grand parade, picnic, fireworks, fun games, and mind-blowing ice cream. Prizes are included!
[*] Explore the Summer Picnic! Earn points and have the most fun holiday ever!
[*] New season! Dive into urban noir and investigate a series of deaths. Mr. X believes they were murders. A vigilante is on the loose in Bärligen! A city of contrasts and era of decadence... All in Mr. X's diary!
[/list]

[list]
[*] The music contest is about to begin! Lexi Orton has every chance to become a star, but only with your help. Join her winning performance and earn prizes! National instruments, and karaoke hits – turn it up!
[*] Explore the Star's Dressing Room! Earn points and have the most fun holiday ever!
[*] We also improved the app's overall stability. Have fun playing!
[/list]

[list]
[*] Spring is in full swing! The cherry blossoms are blooming soon in a faraway land. Let nature charm you with its beauty and whisper the secrets of the universe... Go on a journey with us and check out the Blooming Courtyard!
[*] Explore the Artist's Corner! Earn points and have the most fun holiday ever!
[*] New season! Mr. X feels the call of a dark artifact. Disaster is brewing! He'll have to take on the role of a father, something he secretly craves and fears. Decode the diary and learn the story!
[/list]

[list]
[*] The merriest holiday of spring is coming! Celebrate with us at the Hop Storage! Giovanni Leprecauni and Joshua the Leprekitty are waiting for you to join their fun adventure. Get your gifts in time!
[*] Explore the Leprechaun's Stash! Earn points and have the most fun holiday ever!
[*] New season! The diary is writing the story of young Joanna. She dreamed of saving her family from ruin and set off in search of Druidic treasures. What awaits her on the road of myths? Decipher the diary!
[/list]

[list]
[*] Mystery Manor is going to Venice, for the holiday of love! Decode the flower message together with the brilliant florist Nicole Oliveras. What was the sender trying to say? Get ready for surprises, real emotions, intimate secrets, and presents!
[*] Explore the Love Postcard! Earn points and have the most fun holiday ever!
[*] New Season! The anniversary of the X couple at a masquerade has gone awry. First Madame X's heart was pierced by jealousy, and soon after her rival is found dead...
[/list]

[list]
[*] The New Moon Festival is coming! Immerse yourself in the enchanting atmosphere of Asia, uncover the mystery of the Nian serpent, take part in the parade, feast till your heart's content, and get gifts from the Universe!
[*] Explore the Dragon's Chest! Earn points and have the most fun holiday ever!
[*] We also improved the app's overall stability. Have fun playing!
[/list]

[list]
[*] New Year at Mystery Manor! Winter fun, games, and presents await! And for those who celebrated with us last year, new tasks and collections are ready.
[*] Explore the New Year's Eve Table! Earn points and have the most fun holiday ever!
[*] New season! The southern sea, fiery dancing, and a cruel game in which Mr. X was dragged into with his friend. Is it possible to stay alive and sane? Decipher the diary!
[/list]

[list]
[*] Mystery Manor is getting ready for the holidays. Its residents are already waiting for you in the Christmas court. Fun, wonders, and exciting stories — feel the holiday spirit!
[*] New season! A Christmas miracle graces the life of young astronomer Francis at the very edge of the world... A heartwarmingly dazzling story awaits!
[*] From December 1 to 25, play every day to open the Advent calendar and earn gifts!
[/list]
